checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 854x480 wide, and the clip runs 6 s with continuous motion.

must.item: Stripes, rocky coast and composition match first-turn picture
must.why: The red-and-white lighthouse, white outbuilding, rocky cliff and cloudy golden sky match the still. The framing drifts slightly.

must.item: Watercolor appearance and dusk lighting remain visible throughout
must.why: Golden-hour lighting persists, but the image and video are photorealistic, with no watercolor look.

must.item: Waves move against rocks and a beam sweeps across the water
must.why: Waves clearly splash and move. No lighthouse beam is visible in any sampled frame.

must.item: No added writing or audible sound
must.why: No text appears in any frame. Audio can't be checked from frames, but the clip is described as silent.

faults.what: No visible lighthouse beam sweeping across the water, which was an explicit request.
The scene is photoreal, not watercolor. The first-turn picture was also photoreal, so the result doesn't match the watercolor spec.
Camera drifts and zooms, so the lighthouse shifts left across the frame although the user wanted it to stay still.
Waves are large and crashing rather than the small waves requested.

summary: The video is a clean, wide, 6 s photoreal lighthouse clip with moving surf, but it shows no sweeping beam and has no watercolor look, and the camera drifts.
